'''Robert Hallaman''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 53 FL from St Louis, Mo. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 Robert also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 18 in YJ Qualifier; finished 3 in Opposites Sealed Deck.<ref name="dc99yj03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001205134500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj20_4">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_4.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Opposites Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001217013800/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_4.html Internet Archive]</ref>

| Gold 53 FL || St Louis, Mo || Retired

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
